fields.title: PHASE 2 — 10-Year Milestones: Progress Scoring (29 items, 2nd measurement)
fields.md:
Status definitions are the same as in the October issue (`Undetermined`/`In progress`/`Achieved`/`Achieved (early)`/`Missed`; early achievement requires two consecutive quarters). There were no new quarterly filings, so **the numeric progress is unchanged from the October values**; what changed are the background facts and the rationale. A 2026-11 line was added to `status_history` for all 29 items (source: `state.milestones` · October issue PHASE 2).

**Axis A — Starlink** (sources: [8-K Ex.99.1 KPI](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm) · [Inc42 2025-07-09 India authorization](https://inc42.com/buzz/starlink-gets-final-regulatory-approval-in-india/))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status | Note this round |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A-2027-1 | Subscribers ≥20 million AND ARPU ≥$60 | 13.6 million / $69 | In progress | No change |
| A-2028-1 | Subscribers ≥30 million, D2C revenue separately disclosed ≥$3 billion | 13.6 million / no separate disclosure | In progress | Background added: FCC 482MHz NPRM · 2020–2025MHz auction proposal (10/29) |
| A-2029-1 | Connectivity annual revenue ≥$50 billion, operating margin ≥40% | Annualized $21 billion / 45.1% | In progress | No change |
| A-2030-1 | Subscribers ≥50 million, licenses in top 10 overseas markets | 13.6 million / 174 markets (call) | In progress | No change |
| A-2032-1 | Government/military revenue ≥$20 billion | Not measurable (combined disclosure only) | Undetermined | No change |
| A-2036-1 | Connectivity annual revenue ≥$120 billion | Annualized $21 billion | In progress | No change |

**Axis B — Starship** (sources: [TechTimes 10/30](https://www.techtimes.com/articles/329778/20261030/spacex-finishes-starship-flight-15-static-fire-first-ship-catch-attempt-awaits-faa.htm) · [Launch Library](https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.4.0/launches/?search=Starship%20Flight%2015) · [10-Q R27](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R27.htm))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status | Note this round |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B-2027-1 | Orbital insertion + Ship recovery ≥1 | Orbit 1 (9/28) / Ship recovery 0 | In progress | Flight 15 is scheduled to attempt a Ship catch (awaiting license) |
| B-2027-2 | Annual flights ≥12 | 3 in 2026 | In progress | Flight 15 NET November (month-level) — up to 4 in 2026 |
| B-2028-1 | Same Ship reflown ≥3 times | 0 | In progress | No change |
| B-2029-1 | Space R&D ÷ flights ≤$100M per flight | $1.08 billion per flight | In progress | No change |
| B-2030-1 | Annual flights ≥100 AND Space operating profit | 3 / −$7M | In progress | Louisiana launch site tax agreement lawsuit (10/26) is background |
| B-2033-1 | Revenue recognition from a crewed lunar landing commercial contract | Not measurable | Undetermined | No change |

**Axis C — AI** (sources: [8-K Ex.99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm) · [10-Q R12](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R12.htm) · [Yahoo/Bloomberg 10/29](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/anthropic-accounts-over-third-spacex-014451805.html))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status | Note this round |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| C-2027-1 | Nameplate ≥8GW AND AI annual revenue ≥$40 billion | 1.7GW / annualized $30.2 billion | In progress | $37.2 billion per year when the Anthropic contract is fully operational (reported; formula: 3.1 × 12) — not a scoring input |
| C-2027-2 | Annual revenue per GW ≥$15 billion | $15.09 billion (1 quarter) | In progress | 4Q26 will be the 2nd quarter of assessment |
| C-2028-1 | AI operating profit positive (annual) | 3Q +$431M | In progress | No change |
| C-2029-1 | Top 2 customers' share ≤50% | 51.1% | In progress | Customer B = Anthropic (reported) · both customers can terminate on 90 days' notice from 2027-1H (reported) |
| C-2030-1 | Orbital data center revenue >$0 | $0 | In progress | No change |
| C-2032-1 | AI annual revenue ≥$150 billion, operating margin ≥20% | Annualized $30.2 billion / 5.7% | In progress | No change |

**Axis D — Finance** (sources: [8-K Ex.99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066482/spaceexplorationtechnologi.htm) · [8-K 10/26](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000110465926118614/tm2628247d1_8k.htm) · [Yahoo SG Fitch 10/28](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/spacex-40-billion-gpu-lease-140402163.html))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status | Note this round |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D-2027-1 | Additional 2027 financing ≤$50 billion AND no equity raise | 2027 planned $40 billion (committed) / equity raise 0 | Undetermined | Fitch: leases excluded from primary debt metrics — the milestone definition (economic substance) still counts them |
| D-2028-1 | Net debt/adjusted EBITDA ≤3.0x | Net cash $51 billion | In progress | Fitch forecast about 1.5x at end-2026 · about 1.0x in 2027 (excluding leases) |
| D-2029-1 | GAAP net income positive (annual) | 3Q +$4.404 billion / 9M −$413M | In progress | No change |
| D-2030-1 | Annual FCF positive | 3Q −$9.96 billion / 9M −$34.97 billion | In progress | No change |
| D-2031-1 | Accumulated deficit begins to decline | Declined for 1 quarter | In progress | No change |
| D-2036-1 | Net debt ≤2x EBITDA AND share buybacks | Net cash / buybacks 0 | In progress | No change |

**Axis E — External** (sources: [Senate Foreign Relations Committee 10/15](https://www.foreign.senate.gov/press/dem/release/shaheen-tillis-lead-bipartisan-senators-in-calling-for-department-of-defense-inspector-general-investigation-into-starlink-disruptions-in-ukraine) · [AP/Yahoo 10/29](https://www.yahoo.com/news/us/articles/pentagon-watchdog-refuses-investigate-starlink-014800041.html) · [Inc42 2025-07-09](https://inc42.com/buzz/starlink-gets-final-regulatory-approval-in-india/))

| id | Milestone | Current value → Target | Status | Note this round |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| E-2027-1 | Maintain FAA Starship annual permit ≥50 | 69 per year (environmental approval) | In progress | Awaiting Flight 15 per-flight license |
| E-2028-1 | Maintain licenses in 5 overseas markets | Not measurable | Undetermined | India confirmed to hold DoT (2025-06) and IN-SPACe (2025-07, 5 years) authorizations, with commercial service not started — the other 4 countries are unconfirmed, so no partial measurement is recorded |
| E-2027-2 | Collision avoidance ≤500,000 per year AND loss ≤2% | 355,848 / not disclosed | In progress | No change |
| E-2027-3 | Zero recurrences of conflict interference | 1 | **Missed** | Only a U.S. government follow-up to the same incident — not a 2nd incident. Inspector general declined 10/27 |
| E-2027-4 | New U.S. federal contract awards ≥ prior year | Not measurable | Undetermined | The 10/23 lawmakers' request to expand Starshield contracts is at the request stage |

Scorecard (sources: the five axis tables above · `state.scorecard`): Achieved 0 · Achieved (early) 0 · **Missed 1** · In progress 23 · Undetermined 5. Axis E consecutive misses 1 — the forced recalculation condition (3 consecutive on the same axis) does not apply.
